value.rationale: The cyclic 3-composition histogram is a natural low-resolution substring readout. Exact image characterization and optimal zero-error code size at every n are nontrivial because cyclic wraparound adds sharp forbidden boundary profiles absent from linear observations. The theorem gives constructively a complete all-length classification and a degree-three period-three capacity law; significance does not rest on computation or mod-three conservation alone.
